bundle_shift_swap_desc: Shift swap requests between employees: propose, accept, apply as a manager.
confirm_delete_swap: Delete this swap? The shifts will be reverted to their original state.
no_future_shift_colleague: This colleague has no future shifts.
select_employees_to_continue: Select two different employees to continue.
step_2_my_shift: 2. My shift (that I want to swap)
step_3_his_shift: 3. His shift (that I want to take)
swap_accepted_wait_manager: Swap accepted — waiting for manager validation.
swap_conflict_error: This swap would create a conflict: one of the employees would end up with two shifts on the same day.
swap_conflict_hint: Shifts that would create a conflict (the other employee already has a shift that day) are not offered.
swap_deleted: The swap was deleted and the shifts were reverted to their original state.
